text:
Maya L.: quick prototype pushed: sampled-cost cards in Console that show extrapolated token spend + uncertainty. experimenting with stratified weights. pls review.
Evan (platform): link?
Maya L.: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/feature/sampled-costs
Jon R.: Nice. what's the sampling axis? route? model? tenant?
Maya L.: primary stratification = (route_id, model_sku, cache_hit). keeping sample_policy_id on each row so we can track policy changes.
Priya: Good. we should also keep the raw token distribution snapshot for the sampled batch so we can bootstrap CIs instead of assuming normality.
Evan (platform): agree. For SQL rollups I sketched an estimator that handles variable weights: SUM(token_cost * weight) / SUM(weight) * total_count_estimate pattern. e.g.

```
-- pseudo
WITH s AS (
  SELECT route_id, SUM(weight * token_cost) AS weighted_cost, SUM(weight) AS total_w, COUNT(*) AS sampled
  FROM inv_samples
  WHERE sample_policy_id = 'v2'
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT route_id, (weighted_cost / total_w) * est_total_invocations AS est_cost, sampled
FROM s
```

Jon R.: Remember weight = 1/sample_rate only if independent. for stratified/oversample we record explicit weight. keep weight typed as decimal.
Priya: UX: I think these cards must never replace the billing panel. label them as "operational estimate (sampled)" and show both estimate and sample coverage (n / est_total).
Maya L.: Proposal: collapsed by default, show sparkline of estimated cost with a translucent CI band. hover shows sample_policy_id, sample_rate_by_bucket, and a small "Compare to full capture" action.
ui-bot: mockup uploaded: https://design.internal/r/sampled-cost-card/v1.png
Evan (platform): ops: ingestion needs an extra column (sample_policy_id, weight, snapshot_metrics json). snapshot_metrics = {p50_tokens, mean_tokens, p95_tokens}. that last one could be a stringified json until we migrate.
Jon R.: Can we avoid JSON columns? they're slow for some queries. Maybe structured columns p50_tokens, p95_tokens, mean_tokens.
Maya L.: ok i'll change to explicit columns. also adding sample_policy_start_ts so we can filter windows where policy changed.
Priya: We should run a replay comparison: capture full traffic for 30m on a heavy route, then replay sampler to produce estimates and measure absolute & relative error. If error < 3% for >1k inv/hr at 5% sampling then OK.
Evan (platform): schedule note: materialized cost_view will need a backfill migration to populate weight column for historic rows; that'll be a downtime-free migration but needs partition replan. can we coordinate?
Maya L.: I'll open an RFC for the migration and list preferred maintenance windows.
Jon R.: Edge case: canaries. if canary has different prompt shapes, global extrapolation will be biased. we must expose canary_id in strat keys and ensure the Console drilldown surface shows canary vs prod.
Priya: Also flag low-sample routes (sampled_invocations < 50) to show extremely wide CI and a CTA: "Increase sampling on this route" with a one-click escalation to request higher sampling from infra.
Evan (platform): infra will accept an API call to adjust sampling policy per-route; needs auth guard. I'll add endpoint `POST /sampling-configs/adjust` (internal only).
deploy-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-proto-v3 (sha: c1a2b3) -> canary cluster-a
Maya L.: Tests: unit for estimator math, integration for dashboard aggregation, and a playback job to compare against full capture. I'll post test results.
Priya: docs: we need a short explainer: formula, when it's safe, how to read CI, and a clear "Not for billing" badge.
Jon R.: small nit: use % rather than absolute token cost in some contexts, because unit cost varies by model SKU and quantization. showing both is fine.
Maya L.: thanks. will iterate on copy. I'll update the branch with explicit columns and the replay job output tomorrow. :rocket:
